title: Detail Upscale
description: Crisps up a picture that was enlarged from a smaller source, live on the GPU. An edge push pulls blurry ramps back toward steps and a contrast-adaptive sharpen (after AMD CAS / FSR RCAS) adds crispness without halos. Set Source scale to how many times the picture was stretched. Classic reconstruction, not a neural network: it sharpens what is there but cannot invent new detail (use the AI upscale step of the Import wizard for stills). Works on the camera, a dropped clip, the demo, or the layers below in the Mixer/Patch.
